description: DACULA, GA — Former State Representative Farooq Mughal supports requiring data centers in Gwinnett County to obtain a Special Use Permit before development.Currently, data centers are classified as M-1 (Light Industrial) zoning, which allows automatic approval for data center use. Mughal said projects with significant energy, water, infrastructure, and community impacts deserve additional local review.“Data centers are an important part of our technology economy, but communities deserve a voice
title: Former State Representative Farooq Mughal Supports Special Use Permit Requirement for Data Centers in Gwinnett County
